actions.action: Tip the plant out of its pot and inspect the roots
If roots are brown or mushy, trim them with clean scissors and dust with cinnamon
Check leaf undersides with a white paper towel for mites or thrips
Empty the drainage tray after every watering
Finger-test the soil and water only when the top 2–3 cm are dry
Repot into a 1:1 perlite and potting mix in a pot with a drainage hole
Move the plant out of direct sun into bright indirect light

reason: The answer blames the leaf damage mainly on sun scorch and treats soggy dense soil as a co-cause, so the diagnosis is only partial, but its root check, reduced watering and repot into a chunkier mix match the confirmed fix and nothing in it is harmful.
